text.en:
Adjustment of Dividend Rate. Pursuant to Section 5 of RA No. 7656, the
percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the OFBank to the National
Government for CY 2016 is adjusted from fifty percent (50%) of its annual net earnings to
0%.

Coverage. The adjusted dividend rate set forth in Section 1 of this Order
is applicable only to the OFBank for CY 2016.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 5th day of August
Two Thousand and Twenty-One.
in the year of Our Lord,
By the President:
